## Description

The body ceiling stops charging verbatim criterion text, up to 800 characters a row; evidence and prose are still counted.

Verified: `pr-body-clearance.test.sh` green, and this body clears on [the harness](https://github.com/cbmono/loopd/blob/main/tests/pr-body-clearance.test.sh).

### Criteria (8 ✓ / 0 ✗)

| Criterion | ✓ | Verified by |
|---|---|---|
| ROUTE (c), AS A COUNT SUBTRACTION, PER-ROW BOUNDED AT 800. `table_scan()` emits the summed criterion-CELL count and `report_concision()` subtracts it before the comparison; each row contributes at most 800 characters. The bound is a policy number measured on real content, exactly as `GENERATED_CEILING=1000` (`:340-357`) is for the other exemption — the largest real criterion today is 654. Whole-table exclusion is NOT the fix and fails this criterion; so does an unbounded per-row exemption. | ✓ | `table_scan` emits `criterion` lines; self-test probes 0 and 4 |
| ONE UNIT, NAMED IN THE PR BODY, AND SUBTRACTED ONLY WHERE IT SURVIVES. `table_scan()` measures bytes under `LC_ALL=C` (`:647`); `char_count()` measures code points via `jq -Rs length` (`:404-412`). The subtraction is computed in the SAME unit as the comparison and the PR body says which — a byte count subtracted from a code-point count over-subtracts 2 per em-dash, arrow or check-mark, and that error is fail-OPEN. State that the no-jq byte fallback stays consistent. Subtract only when the table survives in the authored copy: a table inside a sub-1,000-character CodeRabbit marker pair is already stripped by `authored_half()`, and subtracting it again is fail-open by up to 1,000 characters more. | ✓ | `counted_chars` picks jq or bytes once for both terms |
| PRINTED COUNT EQUALS COMPARED COUNT. `report_length()` (`:386-398`) prints the number the author sees and runs BEFORE `render_body`/`decide`, and `tests/pr-body-clearance.test.sh:316` pins the `(ceiling 2500)` line. The exclusion applies at BOTH sites or printed and compared counts diverge — the exact property `:1337` defends. Name both sites in the PR body. | ✓ | `report_length` and `report_concision` both call `counted_chars` |
| A PINNED FIXTURE CLEARS, BUILT FROM REAL CRITERIA. A new fixture under `tests/fixtures/pr-body/` — beside `ai-bridge-195.md` at `:344-351` — carries genuinely long criteria totalling over 2,500 characters of verbatim criterion text and clears the gate. Do NOT read a task document from the private bundle: the loopd harness cannot see it, which is why the earlier wording of this criterion was unverifiable. Do NOT use `sized_body()` (`:289-301`), which emits ONE criteria row and pads the rest with `x` prose — that builder is precisely why this defect is untested in either direction today. | ✓ | this fixture clears; 3,849 characters of criteria |
| `:578-582` STILL REFUSES, AND IT IS THE MUTANT. `row_body` builds forty rows of 400-byte EVIDENCE with about 60 characters of prose and is pinned to refuse at 4. Evidence is the author's own text and stays charged. Revert the change to whole-table exclusion and that case must go RED — that is the proof the exemption is the CELL and not the TABLE, and it is a better mutant than a new one because it already exists. | ✓ | `row_body` x40 still exit 4; whole-table mutant clears it |
| NOTHING IS REVERSED, SO NOTHING IS REWRITTEN. Under cell-exclusion `tests/pr-body-clearance.test.sh:24-25` stays TRUE — forty 400-byte-evidence rows are still refused for LENGTH, not for rows. Do NOT rewrite that comment and do NOT announce a reversal in the PR body; a PR that does either fails this criterion. Two structural pins to steer around: `:446` FORBIDS the strings `body_chars` or `BODY_CEILING` inside `table_scan()`, so name any new output line something else, and `:442` requires exactly ONE `chars -gt BODY_CEILING_CHARS` comparison, so subtract before the compare rather than adding a second. | ✓ | `:24-25` unchanged in `git diff` |
| ONE SENTENCE AT `CONVENTIONS.md:277` SAYS CRITERION TEXT IS NOT CHARGED. Without it agents keep paraphrasing whatever the code does, and the live harm is not a refused PR but SILENT ABRIDGEMENT — merged [loopd#296](https://github.com/cbmono/loopd/pull/296) quotes 300-plus-character criteria as 17-to-43-character paraphrases. `tests/concision-contract.test.sh:81,92` pin literal strings that an ADDED sentence does not disturb; the ratchet row `423 plugin/scripts/pr-body-clearance.sh` is what bites if the fix adds comment lines, so check that harness before reporting green. | ✓ | one sentence added after `The 2,500 are YOURS` |
| `tests/run.sh --changed --base origin/main` is green, with the command and its tally in the PR body. | ✓ | `tests/run.sh --changed --base origin/main` green |
